theorem probe_n1 : Ehrhart.interiorLatticePoints (Ehrhart.centeredSimplex 1) = {0} := by
  have h : Ehrhart.centeredSimplex 1 = Set.pi Set.univ (fun _ => Set.Icc (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, ⟨h0, hs⟩, rfl⟩ i _
      have h1 := h0 0
      simp at hs
      have : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst this
      simp only [Ehrhart.simplexDilation, Set.mem_Icc]
      push_cast
      constructor <;> linarith
    · intro hx
      refine ⟨fun i => (x i + 1)/2, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · intro i
        have := (hx i trivial).1
        simp only
        linarith
      · have := (hx 0 trivial).2
        simp
        linarith
      · funext i
        simp [Ehrhart.simplexDilation]
        ring
  ext z
  simp only [Ehrhart.interiorLatticePoints, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  rw [h, interior_pi_set Set.finite_univ]
  simp only [Set.mem_pi, Set.mem_univ, true_implies, interior_Icc, Set.mem_Ioo]
  constructor
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hz 0
    have a' : (-1:ℝ) < (z 0 : ℝ) := h1
    have b' : (z 0 : ℝ) < 1 := h2
    have a : -1 < z 0 := by exact_mod_cast a'
    have b : z 0 < 1 := by exact_mod_cast b'
    funext i
    have : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst this
    simp
    omega
  · rintro rfl i
    simp [Ehrhart.integerPoint]
